datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
select distinct
  c.description,a.name,
   CM_COMMON.get_CustCartIpNum(cipinf.idcust )as dd,
   cipinf.name||' '|| cipinf.soname||' '||cipinf.lastname as  "Birge borc alan",
  CREDITLINEAMOUNT,ROUND(months_between ( p.duedatefirstcontract,p.dateofconclusion)) as period,
numberofcredit,DATEOFCONCLUSION ,ic.description as in_description,i.insuranceno,i.insurancedate,
     ic.description  as "sığorta şirkətin adı ",
    i.INSURANCENO       as "Sığorta polisinin nömrəsi",
   i.INSURANCEDATE     as "sığorta polisinin tarixi",
   i.INSURANCEAMOUNT   as "Sığorta haqqının məbləği",
   i.PLEDGEINSLASTDATE as "G sıortasının bitmə vaxtı" ,h.rest "Qalıq",ca.description "Müştərinin tipi"
 from
cm_ip_info i,CM_PORTFOLIO p,CM_USERGROUPS c, smart.customers a,cm_ip_insurances ic,smart.customers cu,
smart.custinfo cipinf,cm_history h,cm_categories ca
where
i.creditid=p.id and ca.id=p.customertype and
p.usrgroup=c.id and
p.boorowerid=a.id and
i.insurancecompany=ic.id and
i.INSURANCEDATE  between :dat and :dat+60 and
cipinf.idcust = cu.id  and
P.boorowerid= cu.id 
and p.id =h.creditid and h.hdate=:dat and h.rest+h.duerest>0

datasets.name: OracleDataSet2
datasets.sql:
select distinct
 c.description,a.name,CREDITLINEAMOUNT,ROUND(months_between ( p.duedatefirstcontract,p.dateofconclusion)) as period,
numberofcredit,DATEOFCONCLUSION ,ic.description as in_description,i.insuranceno,i.insurancedate,

   i.INSURANCENO       as "Sığorta polisinin nömrəsi",
   i.INSURANCEDATE     as "sığorta polisinin tarixi",
   i.INSURANCEAMOUNT   as "Sığorta haqqının məbləği",
   i.PLEDGEINSLASTDATE as "G sıortasının bitmə vaxtı" ,ca.description "Müştərinin tipi"
 from 
cm_ip_info i,CM_PORTFOLIO p,CM_USERGROUPS c, smart.customers a,cm_ip_insurances ic,smart.customers cu,
(select custid,UNIQUEINSID,BB_INN,MONTHLYPROFIT,PASSTYPE,MARRIAGE,INSPOLICNUM,INSPERIODID,insamount,INSCONTRACTDATE,INSCONTRACTPREIOD,INSCONTRLASTDATE,bb_familystatus
,INSURANCECOMP,cardid  from smart.custipinfo 
union
select  custid,null as UNIQUEINSID, null as BB_INN,null as MONTHLYPROFIT,null as PASSTYPE ,null as MARRIAGE,null as INSPOLICNUM,null as bb_familystatus,
null as insamount,null as INSCONTRACTDATE,null as INSCONTRLASTDATE, null as INSCONTRACTPREIOD,null as INSPERIODID,null as INSURANCECOMP, null as cardid
from (
 select id as custid from smart.customers
 minus 
 select custid from smart.custipinfo 
))cipinf,cm_categories ca
where
i.creditid=p.id and ca.id=p.customertype and
p.usrgroup=c.id and
p.boorowerid=a.id and
i.insurancecompany=ic.id and
i.PLEDGEINSLASTDATE < (SELECT SYSDATE FROM DUAL)  and
cipinf.custid = cu.id  and
P.boorowerid= cu.id 
and  p.id  in(
 select creditid
 from creditsmgr.cm_curr_state where 
 (REST<>0 or INTERESTREST<>0))
